blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transport group Manibela staged a protest at its headquarters in Nagtahan, Manila, on Tuesday, Nov. 17, opposing rising oil prices and the US-led Pax Silica initiative as the Philippines hosted the 49th Asean Summit. The group also criticized the P22.9-billion budget allocated for the government’s summit preparations, raising concerns about how economic and political agreements could affect Filipinos’ livelihoods. Manibela said the protest aimed to give drivers and operators a chance to voice their concerns over rising fuel costs, the worsening livelihood crisis, and agreements that could make the country more dependent on foreign powers.
